post.description:
Simulates receiving a PayPal webhook:
  1. Dedupes and records event into BronzeEvent table.
  2. Locates matching Gold reconciliation record by paypal_transaction_id or reference_invoice_id.
  3. Updates match_status to 'matched'.
  4. Broadcasts a 'WEBHOOK_ACK' event to all connected AG Grid WebSockets
     for instant, frame-safe row flashing and status update.

AllowlistedColumn.title: AllowlistedColumn
AllowlistedColumn.description:
Exhaustive whitelist of columns the LLM may reference in filters, sorts,
and groupings. Maps to the AG Grid Column Whitelist from the architecture.

Organised by source table for clarity.

AllowlistedTable.title: AllowlistedTable
AllowlistedTable.description:
Tables the LLM is allowed to query. Restricted to Silver (operational
source of truth) and Gold (accounting evidence) layers.
Bronze is excluded – raw payloads must never be exposed to the AI.

column.description: Column to filter on (must be from the whitelist).

value.title: Value
value.description: Filter value. Required for all operators except is_null/is_not_null. For 'in'/'not_in', provide a list. For 'between', provide [low, high].

FilterCondition.title: FilterCondition
FilterCondition.description: A single filter condition the LLM wants applied to the query.

FilterOperator.title: FilterOperator
FilterOperator.description: Allowlisted SQL operators the LLM may use in filter conditions.

aggregate.description: Aggregate function to apply to grouped rows.

aggregate_column.description: Column to aggregate (required if aggregate is set).

GroupSpec.title: GroupSpec
GroupSpec.description: A grouping specification for server-side grouping in AG Grid.

target_table.description: Primary table to query. The LLM selects from the allowlisted Silver/Gold tables only.

join_tables.title: Join Tables
join_tables.description: Additional tables to JOIN (the compiler resolves FK relationships).

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: WHERE clause conditions. All are ANDed together.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: GROUP BY with optional aggregates for the SSRM datasource.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum rows to return (maps to AG Grid block size).

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of what this investigation does, suitable for display in the AG Grid Investigation Studio.

suggested_actions.title: Suggested Actions
suggested_actions.description: Recommended follow-up actions for the FinOps manager.

InvestigationIntent.title: InvestigationIntent
InvestigationIntent.description:
The AI-to-Grid Contract – the ONLY schema Gemini is allowed to produce.

This Pydantic model is the physical decoupling boundary between
probabilistic AI reasoning and deterministic financial execution.
The LLM produces structured intent; the Read-Only Query Compiler
translates it into allowlisted, parameterised SQLAlchemy queries.

The LLM NEVER sees or produces SQL.

max_results.description: Maximum rows the user wants returned.
